question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2. **
solution:
The correct answer is: **Entirely**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Entirely **refers to Wholly, completely, without exception. (पूर्णतः, पूर्णतया, बिना किसी अपवाद के)

 
 
• **Example**: *The project was entirely successful, meeting all its objectives.*
